measured_platform: Official Windows IROS 2026 practice simulator + Linux ROS Docker
change_note: Only launch_host changed: Windows missing-previous-PID cleanup fix; AST checks confirm driving/planning/timing/watchdog functions unchanged. Windows shortcuts are machine-specific and not included.

saved_followup_snapshot.note: Historical ongoing snapshot only, not the final collision count.

map.note: Rendered genuine prior saved occupancy grid, not a fresh SLAM run or surveyed circuit. Overlay is the actual single-file reference line, not a claim of exact driven wheel trajectory. Equal metric axes; no geometry stretching.

timing_policy: Actual simulator finish/time events with wall-time, distance and coverage cross-checks. Collision/teleport/warmup/flagged-transition laps rejected. Other clean laps remain individual-clean-lap results, not an all-clean-session claim.
safety_policy: SIMULATOR_DIRECT_BENCHMARK_NO_PROXIMITY_GOVERNOR; crash stop disabled by default, explicit STOP/stale-data/host-liveness/heartbeat watchdog retained. Not for physical cars.
dependencies: Existing official simulator, ROS/Docker dependency images and genuine saved track/map memory required. Native transfer archive contains one executable source file only.
